description: M4A/iTunes metadata mapping based on MP4 container and iTunes-specific atoms for audiobooks

©nam.description: Track title - name of the individual track/chapter

©alb.description: Album title - name of the album/book

©ART.audiobook_usage: Narrator name or 'Various' for multiple narrators

aART.description: Album artist - artist for the entire album
aART.audiobook_usage: Author name (primary album artist for audiobooks)

©wrt.description: Composer/Writer - person who composed the work

trkn.description: Track number - track number and total tracks
trkn.audiobook_usage: Chapter number and total chapters (track_num, total_tracks)

disk.description: Disc number - disc number and total discs
disk.audiobook_usage: Disc number for multi-disc audiobooks (disc_num, total_discs)

©too.description: Encoded by - encoding tool or person
©too.audiobook_usage: Encoding software or person who created the files

covr.description: Cover artwork - embedded cover art images
covr.audiobook_usage: Book cover art (typically JPEG or PNG)

©lyr.description: Lyrics - song lyrics or text content
©lyr.audiobook_usage: Chapter text or book excerpt (if applicable)

stik.description: Media Kind - type of media content
stik.audiobook_usage: Set to 2 for audiobook (critical for iTunes recognition)

pgap.audiobook_usage: Set to 1/True for seamless chapter transitions

soal.description: Album Sort Order - sort name for album

soar.description: Artist Sort Order - sort name for artist

soaa.description: Album Artist Sort Order - sort name for album artist

sonm.description: Title Sort Order - sort name for title

freeform_tags.description: iTunes supports freeform tags using ---- atom with format ----:com.apple.iTunes:KEY_NAME
freeform_tags.mutagen_format: Use ----:mean:name format where mean is usually 'com.apple.iTunes'

critical_tags.stik: Must be set to 2 for iTunes to recognize as audiobook
critical_tags.pgap: Should be set to 1 for gapless playback between chapters
critical_tags.aART: Should contain author name for proper album artist
critical_tags.©nam: Should contain chapter title or 'Chapter X' format

audiobook_vs_music_differences.media_type: stik=2 (audiobook) vs stik=1 (music) - critical for iTunes behavior
audiobook_vs_music_differences.gapless_playback: pgap=1 essential for audiobooks, optional for music
audiobook_vs_music_differences.author_prominence: aART (album artist) more important than ©ART for audiobooks
audiobook_vs_music_differences.cover_art_significance: Book cover is primary identifier, not promotional image
audiobook_vs_music_differences.duration_expectations: Individual tracks much longer (chapters vs songs)
audiobook_vs_music_differences.description_usage: desc and ©cmt more commonly used for plot summaries
audiobook_vs_music_differences.series_information: ©grp and freeform SERIES tags common for book series

itunes_specific_behavior.audiobook_recognition: Requires stik=2 to appear in Audiobooks section
itunes_specific_behavior.chapter_navigation: Uses trkn for chapter navigation interface
itunes_specific_behavior.sleep_timer: Special sleep timer features for audiobooks
itunes_specific_behavior.artwork_display: Cover art displayed prominently in audiobook interface
